text.p: UtiliCorp United Inc said Thursday it formed EnTrust Energy Solutions as a new unregulated subsidiary to provide energy services and products to industrial, large commercial, utility, cooperative and municipal markets.
EnTrust will consolidate various UtiliCorp non-regulated energy services businesses previously operated within the company's marketing group.

Gene Martin, president of EnTrust, said the subsidiary will build on some 20 existing projects and develop new applications. Existing projects have contributed sales of nearly $5 million over the past two years and include products and services such as power generation services and gas energy management services.
Presently 25 proposals representing potential sales of $11 million are under consideration by customers.
